title: Democracy Report 2026: expression and civil society under pressure
discussion_signal: V-Dem highlights deterioration in media freedom, academic and cultural expression, civil-society space, and public engagement in policy debate. The post makes voice infrastructure a measurable democratic condition rather than only a legal principle.
linked_research_question: How do restrictions on expression and civil society alter collective action, trust, and the ability to contest power?
limits: Institute summary of its own indicators
Cross-country trends do not show local lived experience
The post does not identify causal mechanisms in individual cases
